items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I think we had Bob Merrill playing the piano then... I had a fight with the guy, Bob Merrill

ctx.x: Well, didn't you have a piano player?
Yeah, we had Skip Hall. No, we didn't have Skip Hall, we -- I think we had Bob Merrill playing the piano then, because Bob had come back from Earl Hines. Yeah.
